prompts.stage: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tall scrolling stage background concept for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive's ON-FOOT top-down run-and-gun mission. Render a portrait 2:3 image, ideally 1024x1536. True overhead / bird's-eye game camera with roofs visible and only short south-facing wall edges, NOT isometric. Rich 16-bit arcade pixel art, crisp chunky pixels, near-black outlines, foliage texture and readable open combat lanes. Travel runs BOTTOM TO TOP. Bottom third: Miami coastal beach arrival, surf and teal ocean along the RIGHT edge, pale sand, damaged empty coastal road entrance and palms. Middle third: large palm-tree park with two turquoise rectangular swimming pools, pale tiled paths, grass islands, hedges and low walls, multiple branching paths and spacious areas to dodge and shoot; several TALL STACKED MILITARY SHIPPING CRATES, 2 or 3 high, form discrete cover clusters with clear gaps between them for sneaking and crawling. Upper third: imposing BRICK-WALLED FORTRESS BASE entrance, reddish dark brick perimeter, heavy barred steel central gate, guard towers, forecourt, more stacked cover crates and a visible paved route through the gate continuing off the TOP edge toward the next level. A gate is the destination to infiltrate, not an impassable decorative building filling the screen. Include long hard wall shadows and crate footprints legible for later cover design. Subtle violet symbiotic corruption on distant walls. No pilots, enemies, vehicles, effects, HUD, labels, flags, numbers, route arrows or text: clean stage art only. Keep bottom-to-top path connected, avoid narrow corridor bottlenecks. Same vivid 16-bit material style as supplied coastal art, but strict overhead gameplay camera.
prompts.hud: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: NEW on-foot top-down arcade HUD FRAME OVERLAY for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. Reference hud.png supplies worn dark gunmetal, rivets, gold/copper bevels, amber lamps, rich 16-bit pixel-art identity. Design for a vertical 480x720 logical playfield, portrait 2:3 output with genuine transparent alpha. Leave the LARGE CENTER 76% of the image entirely transparent for gameplay, and keep interface compact at top and bottom so stealth sightlines stay visible. TOP STRIP: left small empty square pilot portrait socket and three small helmet life icons; center broad empty current-gun icon socket, short EMPTY ammo-number panel, and grenade icon beside a small EMPTY count panel; right a small empty radar square with faint grid and border. BOTTOM STRIP: compact three-slot weapon belt, small standing/crouched/prone silhouette stance display, a slim detection meter frame with empty interior, and blank objective panel. The one-hit player uses lives, not a health bar. No health or shield bar, no boss bar, no fullscreen solid bezel covering gameplay, no long ship power stack. Blank inset panels are alpha-transparent and will receive live text later. No text, letters, numerals, labels or logo inside the raster. Controlled cyan accents for awareness, amber for ammo, red tiny alert lamp. All pixel edges sharp, beautiful weathered metal, matching arcade game's illustrated pixel quality. Whole HUD fully contained with edge padding; no stage background or character scene.
prompts.regular: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent extended top-down PILOT ACTION SPRITESHEET. Regular helmeted male pilot from reference, charcoal suit with cobalt-blue armor panels and steel trim, opaque blue helmet and amber visor, black compact gun. Match reference pixel art and anatomy. Make EXACTLY 36 isolated sprites in SIX COLUMNS x SIX ROWS, equal square cells, generous 20% transparent gutters, same pilot scale and top-down three-quarter arcade camera in every cell. All actions face EAST/right; never turn into a front-view portrait. Fixed waist/pivot in each cell, whole silhouette contained. Genuine alpha background. No cell boxes, labels, text, scenery, floor, drop shadows or drawn guide lines. Each half-row is a THREE-FRAME animation, ordered left to right; row has two separate actions. ROW1 cols1-3: lean into tall cover with rifle tucked, reach with hand and TAP WALL twice (no actual wall drawn). cols4-6: standing to DUCK and lie PRONE with gun pointed right. ROW2 cols1-3: low PRONE CRAWL to right, alternating elbows/knees. cols4-6: grenade throw windup, arm overhead release of small grenade, follow-through. ROW3 cols1-3: RUNNING SHOULDER ROLL ending flat PRONE aimed right. cols4-6: shoulder ROLL then rebound to STANDING gun-ready. ROW4 cols1-3: HIT recoil frames, braced stagger, armor spark; cols4-6: STUN wobble frames with two tiny stars above helmet. ROW5 cols1-3: RECOVERY from knees to standing ready; cols4-6: DEATH fall from knees onto side with helmet still on, no blood. ROW6 cols1-3: REVIVE, prone to knee to standing with subtle cyan aura; cols4-6: POWERUP acquisition, rifle lifted with small amber/cyan energy flare. Keep same body, helmet and weapon geometry, expressive clear distinct action changes; no duplicate idle sprites. Pixel art, hard edges, no smooth render. These are production motion candidates to be extracted as separate frames.

prompts.weapons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 30 individually isolated TOP-DOWN ground gun pickups and breakable powerup crate states for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. STRICT FIVE COLUMNS x SIX ROWS equal cells, generous alpha gutters, each object centered and complete. Genuine transparent background. Same rich 16-bit arcade pixel art, hard clusters, black outlines, charcoal/gunmetal with copper trim and emissive color per gun. NO letters/text/numbers, no floor, no HUD, no characters. Each ROW is one weapon family, consistent between its cells. COLUMN1: recognizable weapon pickup silhouette seen high overhead, muzzle faces RIGHT. COLUMN2: CLOSED reinforced powerup box showing a small pictogram of that gun on its top face, isolated box. COLUMN3: same box CRACKED and damaged with seams bursting. COLUMN4: same box BROKEN OPEN, detached lid and contents glow but no weapon sprite attached. COLUMN5: associated AMMO PICKUP. ROW1 Desert Eagle heavy silver pistol, amber badge; pistol magazine ammo. ROW2 Spread Shotgun chunky black pump shotgun, green badge; shell bundle ammo. ROW3 Minigun multi-barrel gun and feed pack, red badge; belt of bullets ammo. ROW4 Fusion Beam futuristic cyan-white beam rifle, cyan badge; energy battery ammo. ROW5 Napalm Launcher squat orange tank-fed incendiary launcher, orange badge; fuel canister ammo. ROW6 Rocket Launcher heavy olive/steel tube with red tip, violet badge; rocket bundle ammo. These pickups represent ship abilities translated to on-foot gun forms, NOT ship pictures. Distinct silhouettes and color coding readable at 32px; crate states share exact scale. No smooth gradients or photorealism. No overlapping cells.
prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular top-down stealth stage props and grenade sprites for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive, style reference is the Miami beach/park/brick fortress stage. Transparent sheet EXACT FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, 16 isolated independent objects, generous empty gutters; no text/grid, no ground rectangle, no character, no labels. Consistent high overhead gameplay view with roof/top visible, small south-facing edge for height. Crisp 16-bit pixel art and dark outlines. ROW1: col1 single tall olive military crate; col2 TWO-high stacked crates; col3 THREE-high stacked crates with straps; col4 L-shaped group of tall crates for corner cover. ROW2: col1 long reddish brick wall segment with capstone; col2 brick corner segment; col3 heavy barred steel fortress gate CLOSED between small brick piers; col4 SAME gate OPEN with doors folded apart and empty gap. ROW3: col1 green hand grenade with pin; col2 grenade pickup bundle of three; col3 ammo supply crate closed with bullet pictogram; col4 same ammo crate smashed/open with scattered casings. ROW4: col1 gray steel breakable supply box closed; col2 same box cracked; col3 same box breaking with detached lid and debris; col4 same box empty broken shell. Match palette and scale family; tall stack footprints must be readable from tops and strong short south edge. Keep all individual sprites completely inside cells. Genuine alpha transparency. No baked cast shadows, those are separate later engine layers.
prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TOP-DOWN symbiotic ALIEN ROBOT ENEMY spritesheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive on-foot mode. Exact SIX COLUMNS x SIX ROWS, 36 complete isolated sprites, strict equal cells and broad transparent gutters. Genuine alpha background, NO labels, scenery, pilot humans, text, cell borders or shadows. 16-bit arcade pixel art matching supplied helmeted pilot quality; charcoal alien steel, magenta symbiote veins and tiny cyan/red sensors. High overhead gameplay camera, top surfaces dominant, NOT side profile. Each row is six states of one consistent unit. ROW1 light biped ALIEN ROBOT SCOUT with compact rifle: col1 patrol north, col2 patrol east, col3 patrol south, col4 fire east, col5 damage sparks, col6 destroyed robot wreck. ROW2 HEAVY ALIEN ROBOT TROOPER broad armored limbs and twin forearm guns, same six states. ROW3 fixed alien GUN TURRET on square floor mount: aim north, aim east, fire east, damaged, destroyed wreck, separate turret base alone. ROW4 enemy LIGHT TANK north-facing: idle whole assembled, tread-motion whole, firing whole, damaged whole, wreck, detached turret only; identical chassis geometry across first four. ROW5 enemy HEAVY TANK north-facing with twin cannons: same six states. ROW6 AIR UNITS: crescent scout drone north, same firing, same wreck; biomechanical gunship north, same firing, same destroyed debris. Leave weapons/projectile trails separate except small attached firing flash; avoid overlapping cells. Distinct silhouettes and readable armor, robots take multiple hits later. All objects fully contained, no cut-off cannons.
prompts.fx: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: on-foot WEAPON PROJECTILE AND EFFECT sprite sheet for Bullets of Fury — Overdrive. EXACT SIX COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 36 independent complete transparent sprites, no text, cells, labels, background, people or guns. Genuine alpha. Sharp 16-bit pixel clusters and dark controlled outlines. Broad gutters so explosion pixels do not cross cells. TOP-DOWN effects, muzzle/projectiles point RIGHT, blasts centered at common fixed center and same scale in each row. ROW1 six distinct advancing shared small golden MUZZLE FLASH animation frames: ignition to starburst to embers. ROW2 six different projectile graphics: heavy Desert Eagle slug with short amber trail; Spread Shotgun five-pellet fan; Minigun long fast tracer; cyan-white Fusion Beam segment; orange Napalm glob with flame tail; olive Rocket with red nose and short smoke tail. ROW3 columns1-3 Fusion Beam sustained straight cyan energy channel three pulse phases, equal start/end; columns4-6 Napalm ground flame pool three burning phases, circular footprint. ROW4 six hit IMPACT spark animation frames orange/white against robot armor, start small expand then dissipate. ROW5 six GRENADE EXPLOSION frames, compact bright flash then expanding orange shock ring smoke/debris and fade. ROW6 six ROCKET EXPLOSION frames, heavier directional orange blast, outward shrapnel then smoke fade. All entire bursts visible within cells, no clipping and no duplicate stills; flame and blast stages explicitly change. Pixel-art FX only. Keep scale consistent across animation row, no smoothing.
prompts.stealth: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: transparent ENEMY VISION / STEALTH INDICATOR graphics sheet for a 16-bit top-down run-and-gun game. EXACT FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, 16 separate isolated overlay sprites, equal cells and wide gutters. Genuine transparent background, no environment, character, robot, text or drawn cell borders. Crisp stepped pixel edges. First THREE ROWS have FOUR ANIMATION PHASES of SAME footprint VISION CONE: cone origin centered at bottom of each cell, opens upward/NORTH, about 70-degree fan with curved far edge; identical outline across phases, radial subtle scan bands advancing outward, translucency to see terrain beneath. Row1 CALM/PATROL teal-green cone, four scan phases. Row2 SUSPICIOUS amber cone, four brighter scan phases. Row3 ALERT red cone, four pulsing phases. ROW4 icons left to right: amber QUESTION MARK suspicion icon with dark outline; red EXCLAMATION alert icon; pale cyan SOUND PING three concentric ripples from wall tapping; white/cyan TARGET RETICLE with four brackets and center dot. No Metal Gear logo or copied UI. These are reusable awareness visuals only; later engine will clip cones against walls. No gradients spilling into adjacent cells, every cone and icon completely isolated. Restrained luminosity and readable pixel strokes, 16-bit arcade style.
